blockers: The detector is not wired into package.json or ci.yml. Both are outside DB-015's grant under CP-112 and both are shared artefacts in a dirty worktree a concurrent lane is already editing. Handed to release as HF-DB-015-CI-WIRING. Until it is wired the check runs on nobody's behalf, which is the same position DB-014's detector was in and the reason this is stated as a blocker rather than as a caveat.

The static path is a MODEL of execution, not execution. It is kept honest by the harness, which runs both paths against one PostgreSQL and asserts that no guard the static path calls live is called dead by the server — 0 contradictions over 446 executed sites. The executed path itself OVER-reports by construction, because one psql connection cannot hold two catalog states at once without a transaction per version; the report says so under replay.caveat and the finding set of record is the static path's. This is the honest cost of splitting the instrument so the CI path needs no database, and it is named rather than buried.

405 of 567 guard sites are `unanalysed` rather than decided, and 172 of those are guards over pg_policies whose verdict depends on a 1,287-policy replay this module does not perform. That class is owned by DB-014's CP-107 instrument. The remainder are unrecognised shapes, catalog-attribute predicates, unmodelled conjuncts, and conditional or deferred creates. A blind spot is not a clean bill of health and the report uses those words.

A chain replay cannot tell you what a TARGET contains. DB-002 established that migrations have been applied through the Management API, so a target may hold relations the chain never created and may be missing relations it did. 20260414140500:41 is the live instance: it relocates the moddatetime extension, which the PLATFORM creates, so the block is dead on the chain and possibly live on staging. That is why DB-013's migration ships anyway, and it is why a target-side question needs a preflight query rather than a better static analysis.

checkpoints.correction_to_the_brief: The brief asked for the third, fourth or fifth instance, and for the class to be corrected if it were narrower than CP-109 claims. Both halves are answered and they point in opposite directions. WIDER: the class is four spellings, not one, and 15 RLS-policy blocks over 8 tables rather than two. NARROWER: 47 of the 53 are correctly inert, so CP-109's 'not a weaker control, it is an absent one' is right for the high instance and wrong for the other 52 in aggregate. The most useful single result is not a new exposure but a measured historical one: DB015-K12's three-month window on tour_vendors, which is the only place in the chain where a never-executed block demonstrably left a permissive policy in force, and therefore the only place where this class produced a disclosure rather than a gap in the paperwork.
checkpoints.self_audit: Five defects in this detector are recorded in report.json under defectsFoundInThisDetector and each is pinned by a fixture or a test. SELF-1 whole-condition polarity inferred from any `not exists`, inverting every conjunction (four false positives in security-named files). SELF-2 only the `then` arm measured, so an inverted guard's `else` control was reported dead (three live enable-row-level-security policies). SELF-3 a drop-policy block at HIGH because a quoted policy name with spaces was read as the next bare word, yielding the policy named `on`. SELF-4 a trailing \s+ eating the mask's blanks, the same capture from a second site. SELF-5 the mask blanking every dollar-quoted span, so a DO body scanned through it was empty and the detector found ZERO guard sites in the whole chain — a clean report from a broken instrument, caught by the anti-vacuity gate. The general form, which is the reusable part: every one was a matcher slightly too loose producing a confident wrong answer, in the same direction as the answer it was meant to replace. A sixth finding was a test asserting a property the code does not have — that a unit separator protects row boundaries as well as column boundaries — and the test was corrected to assert what is true rather than the check being weakened.
